standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.npc: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.

standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.player: I'll just be over here if you need me.

standard-dialogue-with-book-o-piracy.npc: Wanna buy some clothes? Good quality, none of yer rags.

steps.npc: Then what are you doin' in my shop? Move along.

options.text: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?

steps.player: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?

steps.npc: It's to put your head through.

steps.player: In the stomach? Isn't that an odd place for a neck hole?

steps.npc: Oh! It seems as if I must have slipped while cleaning it and put a bit of a hole in the front.

steps.player: What were you cleaning it with, a blood-covered scimitar?

steps.npc: If I say yes will you buy it?
Then no, I was not cleaning it with a blood-covered scimitar.

steps.player: Where do you get these clothes?
You found a bunch of slashed up clothing, some of which has been shoddily cleaned and stitched together?

steps.npc: Look, do you want in on this or not?
Then what are you doin' in my shop? Move along.

options.text: Where did that pillar come from?

steps.player: Where did that pillar come from?

steps.npc: Would you buy it if it was?

steps.player: If it was could you sell it to me?

steps.npc: If I couldn't would you still give me the money?

steps.player: Where did this pillar come from?

steps.npc: Dunno. There are a load of islands out this way, and a lot of them have little bits and pieces like this scattered around.
The way I see it, there must have been some people out here at one point, then they went away.
